dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, prominent white wing bar is visible across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark wing body.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale blue-white edges are visible along the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, roughly circular high-contrast white patch is visible on the central nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp and distinct linear boundary separates the dark crown from the yellowish-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant blue-gray coloration on the tail rectrices and wing flight feathers contrasting with the green-yellow mantle.
